messages:
mike: Heads up — nightly bench failed during the kv-cache GC step, looks like a lease TTL/race. Blocking daily metrics. Anyone able to triage?
ci-bot: nightly-bench job #202 failed: exit 1 (see https://ci.redwood/teams/eng-ml/jobs/202)
mike: pasted log excerpt:```
E KVCacheGC: lease 0x8f expired while sweeping shard 12
ERROR restart triggered, OOM on gpu-2
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "bench_runner.py", line 421, in sweep
    gc.collect_shard(shard)
RuntimeError: LeaseExpired
```
sasha: on it, grabbing the job artifacts and repro locally now. can you confirm job id?
mike: job id is nightly-bench/202 (linked above). I also saw a short window where restart handler tries to reclaim then immediately restarts another worker.
sasha: repro'ed locally with a small shard, can trigger the exact same Traceback. quick experiment: bumping lease TTL from 5s -> 30s avoids the failure, also adding a small retry/backoff in the sweep loop fixes flake.
oliver: what's the risk of bumping TTL in prod? any latency/cost effects?
sasha: low risk — TTL only governs how long a sweep holds the shard lease. Increasing it increases overlap window slightly but avoids premature LeaseExpired during heavy GC. I'll add a retry with exponential backoff as well.
julian: good call. if this regressed recently we should bisect to the PR that introduced the race. quick scan suggests #5563 (kv cache refactor) touched the lease semantics.
mike: marking the failing test as flaky in CI so it doesn't block other pipelines, will queue a rerun after PR.
build-bot: queued: nightly-bench/202-rerun (triggered by @mike)
ci-bot: rerun started for nightly-bench/202-rerun
ci-bot: rerun passed for nightly-bench/202-rerun :white_check_mark:
sasha: opened PR #5620 — increase lease TTL to 30s + retry/backoff in collect_shard. linking tests and local repro. pinging @oliver for quick review.
oliver: skimmed, looks fine. small comment about backoff cap. LGTM pending green CI :thumbsup:
mike: thanks all — merging once CI green, will monitor next scheduled run. reopening if it resurfaces.
